title: Phishing Awareness
what: Phishing uses deceptive messages to influence unsafe actions.
why: It can lead to credential theft or fraud.
signs: Urgency, unexpected links, credential requests, impersonation.
safe: Verify through an official channel and report suspicious messages.

title: Password Security
what: Strong unique passwords reduce account takeover risk.
why: Password reuse increases the impact of a breach.
safe: Use long unique passphrases and a password manager.

title: MFA
what: Multi-factor authentication adds another verification factor.
why: It reduces reliance on passwords alone.
safe: Never approve an unexpected authentication request.

title: Ransomware Awareness
what: Ransomware can disrupt systems and encrypt data.
why: Downtime and recovery costs can be significant.
signs: Unexpected file changes or suspicious messages.
safe: Maintain backups, patch systems, use least privilege and monitoring.

title: Safe Browsing
what: Safe browsing reduces exposure to deceptive websites.
why: Malicious or deceptive sites can steal information.
safe: Use trusted bookmarks and verify domains.

title: Incident Reporting
what: Early reporting helps defenders investigate quickly.
signs: Unexpected security events or suspicious requests.
safe: Use your organization's approved reporting channel.
action: Report rather than investigate suspicious infrastructure yourself.
